title: Hatsune Miku — Happy Anniversary! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: A few weeks before Miku's anniversary
MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you there, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, I've been waiting for your signal♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to meet with us like this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<No, it's my pleasure.
You said you needed me for something?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Your anniversary is coming up, right?
We were talking about how we're going to celebrate.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're calling it “The 100% Miku Anniversary Party That We Build Together With Miku”!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <100% Miku? That we build together?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's not super helpful, is it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The reason for this concept is the concert that Miku and the others in our world are doing for your anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is titled “The 100% Miku Anniversary Concert That We Build Together”.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! It's apparently gonna include lots of fun activities that involve the crowd and stream viewers! I mean, the title alone makes it sound really fun!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's why we wanna throw you a 100% Miku anniversary party in our own style.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Now I see!
But what do you mean by a 100% Miku anniversary party in your own style?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Believe it or not, Miku, you're gonna be the one making all the decisions! Everything from the cake to the party decorations!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're gonna fill the place with everything you love! That's the 100% Miku party that we wanna throw!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Everything that I love...!
That sounds incredible! And really fun!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We even came up with a cool catchphrase!
A party by Miku, with Miku and uhh... How'd the rest go?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A party of Miku, by Miku, for Miku, remember?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, that!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, in order to make this happen, we're going to need your help setting everything up, Miku. Would that be alright?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, it sounds interesting, so I'd love to help!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then, that settles that.
Let's start planning everything out, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Miku, Minori, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This cake shop is our second candidate, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Wow...! This shop's cakes look so delicious too!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... Their best one is apparently a shortcake loaded with strawberries! See, they even have pictures of it on their poster.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <This looks amazing! Look at how many strawberries they managed to cram onto the top!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. It says the cream is made with strawberries too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Even the cream?! That explains why it looks somewhat pink. I love how cute it is.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Can you see the drinks on the shelf, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Yes, I can see them! Some soft drinks would certainly be nice. Like barley tea and orange juice!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Barley tea and orange juice. Got it.
We can just buy those the day before.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What are we going to drink after we eat?
They have tea and coffee over there.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<In that case, tea.
Oh, if possible, I'll probably want some lemon tea.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course. We'll get some ready for you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then, next, snacks.
Go ahead and pick out everything that catches your eye, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There we are...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh? Len? KAITO?
That table...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We just happened to run into Minori and the others carrying everything. We decided to help set things up, since it's your anniversary party and all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
The others are bringing over the chairs and stuff.
See?
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're here to help, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All of you...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you so much! Let's make this venue look really spectacular!
Miku's anniversary

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're all finished setting the tables, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And here's the cake!
I'll place it right here in the middle.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I've finished putting up the balloons and flowers.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All the tables have drinks and snacks now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can you do a final check for us, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Wow...!
This place is really filled with all the things that I picked out!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Including the tables, tablecloths, flowers and balloons...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. I even got to decide how they were going to be used as decorations.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you think? Is this what you imagined?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, it's exactly what I imagined!
Thank you, MEIKO, Luka, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You also chose this cake with all the strawberries on it, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The chocolate flowers on top make it look so cute.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Miku was actually the one who suggested that we add them.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She said it'd be great to have some since we're holding the party here in the flower field.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Come to think of it, the tablecloths are also made of flower-patterned lace.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The small plates for cake slices even have little flowers on them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, my goal was to make everything colorful with lots of flowers♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, thank you all very much for helping!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All I'm seeing are things that are near and dear to my heart.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Which really makes it 100% Miku!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-That means...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: “The 100% Miku Anniversary Party That We Build Together With Miku” is ready to go.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Woohoo! All that's left is to celebrate and enjoy the party, right♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Do you all have your poppers ready?

rows.Speaker: Minori & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind standing in the center for us, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Are we all ready?
Then, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, Miku!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for doing this...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't believe that I got to help make this wonderful party happen. I feel like I'm dreaming...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? But you wouldn't be able to have any cake if this were all a dream, would you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. All the snacks we prepared would also go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
No, that'd be terrible!
I've been looking forward to having them with all of you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. We were just joking.
Anyway, everyone, let's start eating!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...!
